title: Stratbase backs probe into Chinese inflows to Duterte-linked firm

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Think tank Stratbase Institute on Tuesday backed an investigation into funds reportedly received by a company linked to Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband from China-linked businesses over potential foreign interference. Stratbase Institute President Victor Andres “Dindo” Manhit expressed support for the National Security Council’s (NSC) move to look into the allegations unveiled during Duterte’s impeachment trial.
